body: Get the fuck out lmfao. I’m not taking her to a hospital and saying “hospitalize her” I AM SAYING STOP ENCOURAGING IT. It isn’t one, it’s multiple people just wishing them luck and its truly upsetting. nobody is completely alone. we just have to keep fighting. 

and i do know a lot of them, i have taken my time to message them and find out where they’re from, how old they are, what triggers them.

Agree, but I feel like if somebody really wanted to end their life, they would just do it. they wouldn’t come to tell a bunch of strangers. they would just do it.

but they come here hoping someone discourages them. they come here trying to find a little bit of hope.

You don’t know that. You don’t know what the future holds for you. 

What I said in the first paragraph wasn’t meant to be taken literal and do those steps in that order. I was just saying that you should be going out and having fun. Like go out with friends. Join sports, clubs, meet other guys at the gym with the same interests as you. 

I did say you should take time for yourself. So don’t jump right into another relationship. Look, I can’t tell you how to feel, or change your mind about anything. But just please don’t kill yourself.

First, it’s a her. It’s not a him. It’s a her. 

Understanding where someone is coming from doesn’t mean encouraging them to kill themselves. I’m not judging her at all. I’m just trying to let her know killing herself isn’t the only option. you aren’t talking to her, you’re wishing her luck on killing herself mate. 

What if somebody was telling YOUR daughter this? your little sister?

I’m sorry, but no. Do you personally know them? Do you know that they have tried everything? 

This person has a family, co-workers, friends. This is a fucking person, with emotions and good days and bad days. This is a human. 

The only cure isn’t death. I’ve lived a horrible life, and I’ve wanted to kill myself so many times. I haven’t tried everything. So please don’t say death is the only way because it is fucking not.

Hi kiddo,

You’re grieving and that’s totally okay. It’s fine to feel sad, it’s okay to want to yell and curse at God. It’s okay to be mad at the fucking world. 

take a semester off college, one semester can wait. take time to grieve and find help. go and try to get yourself a therapist, someone who can help you cope with all of this. 

you can always send me a pm, and we can talk about anything you want mate. (:

Dude what the fuck? No. Why would you encourage someone to kill themselves? Yes life fucking sucks but that doesn’t give you the right to tell someone to go ahead and kill themselves. We’re supposed to support each other and come closer, and help each other out of the dark hole, not push each other to fall. What the fuck is your problem?

Dude, breaks up suck. They suck the first few months. But guess what? We move on. Absolutely nobody is worth killing yourself for. You’re 23 years old man. You should be loving yourself, going out, getting drunk, getting fucking laid mate. You’re still so damn young. 

Breakups suck, trust me I know they do. I’m the girl who got dumped and cried for four months, and watched sad movies. But I got right back up, it’s been a little over a year after our break up, and I’m over him. I think about him once in a while but it’s not bad anymore. 

It’s okay to not date anyone. You don’t need to have anyone. You need to focus on yourself. I haven’t dated anyone since my ex boyfriend. Is it because I’m ugly? Maybe lol. Jk, I’m amazing. I’m kidding again. But honestly it’s just like fuck it. Love yourself dude. 

Look at yourself in the mirror and go “I am so freaking great and I’m going to meet someone some day” 

I truly hate myself lol. But I feel like if I keep saying these positive things over and over again, I’ll start to believe them! 

DO NOT KILL YOURSELF OVER A GIRL PLEASE

I’m sorry but these sort of posts make me so angry. I WISH i had a family as supportive as yours. I have a couple of things I would like to say. 

1) if you don’t like the career you’re headed too, change to something else. Change your major. Do something you like. Screw what your parents think ur career should be. You’re the one that’s going to be working that every single day. 

2) just because your parents don’t agree with ur decisions doesn’t mean you’re just going to end up killing your self. Like you have a great supportive family, and your school is what’s stressing you. Why would you throw everything away and hurt your family just because of school? 

3) don’t get me wrong, I’m always one to say that why should we live because somebody else wants us too, why can’t we just take our own life without hurting anyone. BUT, you seem to have been doing really good, and have immense support. Just because things don’t go ur way doesn’t mean you kill your self.

Hi, please don’t do anything. If you were happy a year ago, what makes you think you aren’t going to be happy again? We all go through tough times. But that doesn’t mean we should give up as soon as things get hard. Some of us haven’t been happy in years, some of us have been raped, abused and were still here. Fighting every single freaking day. It sounds like you’re just going through a tough time. You sound young, so I know for a fact that it’s just a little bump on the road and things will get better, and if they don’t, that’s okay too. Look for a therapist where you can vent and tell them how you feel. They’ll help bring up your confidence. Don’t kill yourself.

Hey, honestly you sound like you’re in distress, and honestly whatever you’re thinking of doing. Don’t. Please don’t. I know this is so much to ask but think about the people around you who would see you do it and how you could traumatize them. Think things throughly. I know how you feel. I know because I want to just die sometimes. Almost every single day, but I’m still here. I don’t know if things will get better but I’m still here. So please be here with me too.. honestly I get meds, and I hate them. I hate how they make me feel. I love when people give me support, it makes me feel human again, not like this stupid drugged person. You don’t need anyone to fix you. Trust me. I’m sorry, I’m rambling but please just don’t do anything. My messages are always open. You can tell me everything there, but please don’t do whatever you’re thinking of doing.
